findings.finding: Moving to Dubai and starting a career in real estate without prior experience is perceived as possible.
findings.qualification: Self-reported challenges with moving, such as accommodation issues, suggest the transition is not without difficulties.

findings.finding: Introductory training in real estate is typically brief and informal.
findings.qualification: Evidence of informal training is from observed experiences and may not represent all industry practices.

findings.finding: New agents in real estate often face fear and uncertainty in client interactions.
findings.qualification: These reports are personal experiences and may not reflect all new agents' experiences.

findings.finding: Experienced real estate agents still struggle with defining their sales focus.
findings.qualification: The statement is self-reported and lacks independent verification.

findings.finding: Building confidence is crucial for career development in real estate.
findings.qualification: Confidence-building is self-reported and may not be universally applicable.

findings.finding: Success in real estate is often attributed to the quantity of daily calls made.
findings.qualification: The claim is based on observed behavior and not independently confirmed.

findings.finding: Real estate training opportunities are available even for those without prior experience.
findings.qualification: The opportunities mentioned are observed and may not reflect comprehensive industry offerings.

findings.finding: Challenging moments and feelings of wanting to give up are common in career development.
findings.qualification: This reflects personal experiences and may vary individually.
